summary: Iteration 7 testing complete - Country Hub, Integration Health, Add-Country Wizard, Add-Integration Wizard. All 40 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: Country Hub catalog with 16 countries, 4-step add-country wizard, country detail with 5 tabs and kill switch, Integration Health dashboard with 4 providers, add-integration wizard showing ONLY 3 adapters (Twilio, Tigo TZ, Mock), Settings Hub Geographies group.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL VERIFICATION PASSED: GET /api/admin/country-hub/integrations/available returns ONLY 3 adapters: twilio, tigo_tz, mock. No Infobip/MessageBird/Africa's Talking.
Each adapter has required fields: kind, label, description, channels, fields (with key, label, type, required, default)
GET /api/admin/country-hub returns array of countries with enriched fields: credits_per_sms, routes_count, prefixes_count, operators_count, sender_ids_count, active_sender_ids, health, status
POST /api/admin/country-hub/wizard creates active country with routes, draft without routes. Writes credits.country_rate setting. Wires provider via $addToSet on countries.
GET /api/admin/country-hub/{code} returns full country data: country, credits_per_sms, credits_per_whatsapp, routes (with health and kind), operators, prefixes, sender_ids, health
PUT /api/admin/country-hub/{code}/status sets status to active|paused|draft; rejects invalid
PUT /api/admin/country-hub/{code}/compliance updates opt_out_footer, allowed_sender_patterns, daily_cap, sender_id_required
GET /api/admin/integrations/health returns array of providers with health signal (status, success_rate, sent_24h, creds, last_error)
POST /api/admin/integrations/{provider_id}/test returns {ok, latency_ms, provider_msg_id, status, error}
Frontend Country Hub catalog shows 16 countries with flags, codes, dial codes, rates, routes, sender IDs, health chips
Frontend Add-country wizard has 4 steps: Identity, Pricing, Routes, Compliance with proper validation
Frontend Country detail page has 5 tabs: Overview, Routes, Operators & prefixes, Sender IDs, Compliance
Frontend Routes tab shows ordered route table with priority, operators, cost/SMS, success 24h %, health chip, active pill, Test button
Frontend Compliance tab has editable opt_out_footer, allowed_sender_patterns, daily_cap, sender_id_required with Save button
Frontend Integration Health shows stats (4 integrations, 0 healthy, 2 degraded, 0 down), table with health chips, creds pills, Test buttons
Frontend Add-integration wizard Step 1 picker shows ONLY 3 adapters with info banner: 'Only adapters actually wired into this codebase are listed. We do not expose unintegrated partners.'
Frontend Settings Hub has Geographies group with Country hub and Integration health as module-link CTAs
All iteration 5/6 regression tests passed: auth/me, admin/overview, admin/resellers, commission-audit, settings, providers, countries, reseller/clients, reseller/earnings
seed_data_creation: Countries created during testing: MW (Malawi), ZW (Zimbabwe), BW (Botswana), MZ (Mozambique), ZM (Zambia). Status changes made to MZ (paused, active, draft).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 complete. Phase 2 features fully implemented: (1) Country Hub catalog at /admin/country-hub with 16 countries, stats row, search, add-country button; (2) 4-step add-country wizard (Identity, Pricing, Routes, Compliance) - creates active with routes, draft without; (3) Country detail at /admin/country-hub/{code} with 5 tabs (Overview, Routes, Operators & prefixes, Sender IDs, Compliance), kill switch/activate button; (4) Integration Health at /admin/integrations with stats, provider table, health chips, Test buttons; (5) Add-integration wizard showing ONLY 3 adapters (Twilio, Tigo TZ, Mock) - CRITICAL: no Infobip/MessageBird/Africa's Talking; (6) Settings Hub Geographies group with Country hub and Integration health module links. Existing providers in DB: Tigo Tanzania (Direct), TZ Direct Telco, Twilio Global, Infobip Africa - these are seeded providers, NOT adapters. The INTEGRATED_ADAPTERS list is only used in the add-integration wizard picker.
